name: Fractional Knapsack
description: Maximizes value in a knapsack by taking fractions of items. Greedy approach: take items in decreasing order of value-to-weight ratio.
aim: Maximize total value within weight capacity by greedily choosing items with highest value/weight ratio, taking fractions when needed.
howItWorks: Compute value/weight ratio for each item
Sort items by ratio in decreasing order
If full item fits: take it entirely
Else: take fraction to fill remaining capacity

alternatives: 0/1 Knapsack — when items are indivisible (DP needed)

inputHint: The FIRST number is the capacity, then pairs of (weight, value).
